# highlighted green across all data rows (rows 3, 10, 17, 24, cols C:G)

         '+SUMPRODUCT(--ISNUMBER(SEARCH(L{r},C10:G10)))'
         '+SUMPRODUCT(--ISNUMBER(SEARCH(L{r},C17:G17)))'
         '+SUMPRODUCT(--ISNUMBER(SEARCH(L{r},C24:G24))))'.format(r=r))
    ws.cell(row=r, column=11).value = f

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
EOF
